Shenzhen Eryone Technology Co., Ltd is a globally renowned enterprise specializing in the research, development, and production of 3D printing technologies. Founded in 2018 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, the innovation capital of the world, we have quickly established ourselves as a trusted name in the 3D printing industry.

Eryone focus on building proprietary brand while pursuing international expansion. With strong R&D capabilities, we maintain close collaborative relationships with several prestigious Chinese universities including Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University of Technology, Shenzhen University, and Guizhou University, bringing cutting-edge technological products to the market.

Our team consists of passionate engineers, designers, and industry experts with over 10 years of experience in 3D printing technology development. Leveraging our profound technical expertise, we remain at the forefront of the industry, delivering innovative and reliable solutions to global customers.

Our comprehensive product portfolio spans from desktop 3D printers to industrial-grade equipment, serving various applications including education, prototyping, and manufacturing. We provide OEM manufacturing services for many globally recognized brands. Through our unwavering commitment to quality and consistency, we ensure every product meets the highest standards.

We serve customers in over 100 countries, offering a diverse range of 3D printing products and solutions. Our global presence is supported by localized services, ensuring that we meet the unique needs of each market.
